text:
Sam (AE): Kestrel POC update — ran the midday perf sweep. Short notes.

Diego (Sales Eng): Run details: sustained qps=120, burst to 250 for 2m, seq=512, model=redwood/opt-6.7b-quant, region=aws-us-west-2 :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Diego (Sales Eng): Command we used:
```
loadgen --model redwood/opt-6.7b-quant --qps 120 --max-qps 250 --seq 512 --duration 1800 --clients 48
```

Priya (SRE): Observed numbers:
- avg latency 220ms
- p95 560ms
- p99 1.1s
- tail (~99.9) spikes at 2.6s during burst
- GPU util ~84%, host CPU spiking during KV miss

Marta (Solutions): Can you attach the CSV? Need for the quote and to show on the slide.

Diego (Sales Eng): pasted a small excerpt of the CSV:
```
timestamp,qps,avg_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,gpu_util
1742009999,120,220,560,1100,84
1742010200,250,410,980,2600,92
```

Sam (AE): Kestrel asked 3 things: 1) predictable p95 under 200ms target 2) committed discount for dedicated pool 3) security docs (SOC2 + KMS details)

Priya (SRE): Blocker -> p95>200 because we didn't enable prefix/KV caching for their prompt set. Also their average prompt length jumped to 1k tokens during burst — sequence length matters.

Diego (Sales Eng): Quick mitigation: enable prefix caching + reduce clients to 32 and route bursts to dedicated reserved pool if they commit to 6mo. I can rerun a 30m test by 16:00.

Marta (Solutions): Pricing Q: what's the delta between hosted and dedicated for sustained 120 qps? Also need burst pricing per min over 180 qps.

Sam (AE): I flagged finance — they said committed discount around 25% for 6-12mo capacity + burst add-on at ~1.7x unit price for minutes beyond reserve.

Marta (Solutions): Ok put that in the proposal. Also Kestrel requires HSM-backed keys for model inputs — do we support customer-managed keys/HSM?

Priya (SRE): Yes, Redwood Private supports KMS/HSM & bring-your-own-key integrations; need to confirm network form (VPC peering timeline). I'll attach our security pack in the channel after the thread.

deploy-bot: deployment 1742010105 completed on dedicated-pool-01 :white_check_mark:

Diego (Sales Eng): Action items:
- rerun with prefix caching and clients=32 (Diego) - ETA 16:00
- send CSV and short summary to Kestrel (Sam)
- include draft pricing with 6mo commit + burst add-on (Marta)
- attach SOC2 + KMS docs (Priya)

Sam (AE): Sounds good. If we can show p95 under 200ms with caching and slightly higher commit, Deal looks good. I'll ask them for formal capacity signoff by EOD tomorrow.

Marta (Solutions): +1. Will prepare proposal template.

Priya (SRE): FYI when rerunning include `--seq 1024` test to reproduce long prompt behavior.

Diego (Sales Eng): noted. Rerun scheduled 1742012000.

Sam (AE): Thanks team :pray:
